no-restore-on-exception.detail: TuiRunner.run catches each exception of a key handler (catch Throwable), shows its error screen and keeps the terminal; its close and its shutdown hook restore the terminal. To lose the restore, a program must leave run for a loop of its own and also turn off the shutdown hook: two choices, not one bug
